text:
mira: hey @people-ops — accepted the GitHub invite but I still can't see the infra-config repo. When I try to clone I get 'You must enable SSO' in the web UI and a permissions error on git clone. link: https://imgur.com/example-screenshot
sam: did you accept with your work email or a personal account? that usually causes this
mira: accepted with mira@redwood.ai (work). Command I ran: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra-config.git` -> permission denied (publickey). On the web I get a 404 and a banner about SSO required.
devops-bot: onboarding-checklist: GitHub SSO not authorized for mira (see people-ops)
kevin: can you run `gh auth status` and `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste outputs (sanitized)?
mira: `gh auth status` says: Logged in to github.com as mira (mirawork)
SSO: Required for redwood — NOT authorized
`ssh -T` returns Permission denied (publickey) right now.
sam: try visiting the org page and authorize SSO: https://github.com/orgs/redwood/people — there should be an "Authorize SSO" button if you're signed in with the same account the invite went to
mira: I don't see the authorize button. The invite email says "accepted" though.
kevin: could be a duplicate account issue — check https://github.com/settings/emails and make sure mira@redwood.ai is your primary and verified email, not just secondary
mira: work email is secondary right now. I made it primary but GitHub wants to verify. verification email isn't arriving to my inbox (maybe corp filter). @people-ops can you resend/force?
people-ops: resent the invite and added you to engineering team manually. Check your inbox, click the invite link, then sign in as your work account and accept. I also sent the verification email again.
mira: accepted invite again. Now it says "Pending organization membership" and SSO still shows as not authorized.
sam: if the SSO button doesn't appear, sometimes browser extensions/hardware-auth flows hide it. Do you have a YubiKey registered on your personal account? that can mess with the flow
mira: yes, I registered a YubiKey on my personal account a while back.
kevin: try an incognito window (no extensions) and sign in with your work account, then visit the org page. If you still have the YubiKey interfering, you can temporarily remove it from your personal account Settings -> Security -> Security keys, then re-add later
mira: opened incognito, signed in, and now I can see the "Authorize SSO" button. clicked it and got redirected to Okta to approve. approved.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: welcome @mira! tagging infra leads for repo access.
mira: :tada: I can now see infra-config and just ran `git clone git@github.com:redwood/infra-config.git` successfully
kevin: run `ssh -T git@github.com` as a sanity check — should return "Hi mira! You've successfully authenticated..." and `gh auth refresh` if needed
mira: `ssh -T` now returns the success message. thanks all. For the record: root cause was duplicate/personal account + YubiKey + SSO button hidden in regular browser (extensions?). incognito + ensure work email primary + authorize SSO fixed it.
people-ops: thanks for the notes — we'll update the onboarding checklist: explicitly verify work email prior to accepting invite, mention YubiKey as a possible blocker, and recommend incognito for the initial SSO step. sorry for the friction and welcome aboard, mira!
